title: Temperature correction of the bacterial die off constant

symbols.definition: are values of the constant at T and at 20°C respectively.

applicability: Gives the value of Kb at temperatures other than 20°C, following the statement that a commonly used value of Kb for faecal bacteria at 20°C is 2.0 per day.
notes: The printed definition line writes the subscripts with a space: "K b(T) and K b(20)".
